segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-to-oily skin describe the cream as lightweight and non-greasy, though one with sensitive+oily skin felt it sat on the skin and had a strong scent.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or normal-to-dry skin most often report strong hydration and a rich but non-heavy feel, though one found the daytime version too heavy and greasy for her face.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including combo-dry and combo-oily) report the cream balances hydration without adding shine or oiliness and layers well under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, but a few flag the fragrance as strong or bothersome and one felt the formula sat on her skin.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin, including one with mild dehydration and one using retinol at night, report the cream hydrates well and absorbs quickly without issue.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s, and 70s report visible smoothing of fine lines and a youthful look with continued use, and consider it a long-term staple despite the price.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, plumper skin and softened fine lines with regular use, including several in their 50s-70s who mention fewer visible wrinkles; one reviewer notes it did not do much for her light wrinkles despite added plumpness.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe deep, lasting hydration and a plumped, dewy look, with no negative reports on this concern.
concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers who mention redness say the cream caused none and felt calming, with no dissenting reports.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers report the cream supports comfort and does not disrupt the skin, with no complaints of compromised barrier or reactions beyond the scent issue.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers with sensitive or SPF-reactive skin specifically note this product did not break them out where other sunscreens have, with no contrary reports.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with combination skin reports no acne flare-ups over three years of use, and another with normal, acne-prone skin used it successfully alongside retinol; no breakout complaints appear.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including those with oily or combination-oily skin, report no greasy residue and a matte-to-satin finish, though one sensitive-oily reviewer felt the product sat on her skin before absorbing.

extraits.titre: Strong Scent, Sits on my Skin
extraits.texte: I am on the fence about this moisturizer, I don't think it works for my sensitive + oily skin. It may be better for someone with drier skin and not just dehydrated like me. It initially felt like it would absorb quickly, but even just a little felt like it sat on my skin for like 20 minutes and took a while to rub in. The scent is also pretty persistent and was a little bothersome for me, who can be sensitive to scents in my products. It isn't an unpleasant scent, just strong for me. I do like it has SPF, but won't be rebuying Gifted by Elemis for review

extraits.titre: I would recommend it to my friend
extraits.texte: I've been using Elemis Pro‑Collagen Marine Cream SPF 30 for just over 3 weeks, and as someone with dry skin, I'm already hooked. The texture is silky and gel-like—lightweight yet ultra-hydrating—and absorbs instantly, leaving a soft, satin finish with no greasy residue or white cast. It layers beautifully under makeup. The scent is gentle and elegant, with soft rose and mimosa notes that feel fresh but never overwhelming—lovely to use each morning. Results so far: my skin feels noticeably firmer, smoother, and plumper—especially around my forehead and mouth. Fine lines look visibly softened, and the 24‑hour hydration claim really holds up. The fact it offers broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection means I'm getting daily shield against sun‑induced aging while treating my skin. For dry skin, this cream nails hydration, refining texture and supporting firmness—all in one nourishing, protective formula. Absolutely recommend. Complimentary from Elemis
